battleSceneSelection.layout: 2 bytes per cell: [0] sp_battle_scenes map index, [1] (x % 16) | (y % 16) << 4 -> patch coordinates (x/15, y/15)

periodic.rule: every cell computed at its canonical image; blocks counted from the seam in canonical logical cells

battleSceneSelection.samplingNote: 3x3 points per cell; slivers under about 0.1 of a cell along diagonal face edges can be missed
